translations.literal: =Gao Xi=
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xi

sentences.zh: 高釴，字翹之。

translations.literal: Gao Xi, styled Qiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xi, styled Qiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 祖鄭賓，宋州寧陵令。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zheng Bin was Magistrate of Ningling in Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zheng Bin was Magistrate of Ningling in Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父去疾，攝監察御史。

translations.literal: His father Quji served as Acting Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: His father Quji served as Acting Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 釴，元和初進士及第，判入等，補秘書省校書郎，累遷至右補闕，充史館修撰。

translations.literal: Xi, in the early Yuanhe reign passed the jinshi examination, ranked in the document-judgment category, was appointed Proofreader in the Secretariat, and through successive promotions reached Right Supplementation Censor, serving as compiler at the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: Xi passed the jinshi examination in the early Yuanhe reign, ranked in the document-judgment category, was appointed Proofreader in the Secretariat, and through successive promotions reached Right Supplementation Censor, serving as compiler at the History Office.

sentences.zh: 十四年，上疏請不以內官為京西北和糴使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he submitted a memorial requesting that inner palace officials not be appointed commissioners for grain purchase in the northwest of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he submitted a memorial requesting that inner palace officials not be appointed commissioners for grain purchase in the northwest of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 十五年，轉起居郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Diarist, continuing in his previous additional duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Diarist while continuing in his previous additional duties.

sentences.zh: 釴孤貞無黨，而能累陳時政得失。

translations.literal: Xi was solitary, upright, and without faction, yet repeatedly presented the gains and losses of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was upright and independent, belonging to no faction, yet repeatedly presented the strengths and failings of current policy.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年，穆宗憐之，面賜緋於思政殿，仍命以本官充翰林學士。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changqing, Muzong took pity on him, personally bestowed scarlet robes at Sizheng Hall, and ordered him to serve as Hanlin Academician while retaining his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing, Muzong took pity on him, personally bestowed scarlet robes at Sizheng Hall, and appointed him Hanlin Academician while retaining his original office.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷兵部員外郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of War, continuing in his previous additional duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of War while continuing in his previous additional duties.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，禁中有張韶之變，敬宗幸左軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the Zhang Shao disturbance occurred within the palace; Jingzong went to the Left Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the Zhang Shao disturbance occurred within the palace, and Jingzong went to the Left Army.

sentences.zh: 是夜，釴從帝宿於左軍。

translations.literal: That night Xi accompanied the emperor and lodged in the Left Army.
translations.idiomatic: That night Xi accompanied the emperor and lodged with the Left Army.

sentences.zh: 翌日賊平，賞從臣，賜釴錦彩七十匹，轉戶部郎中、知制誥。

translations.literal: The next day the rebels were suppressed; the emperor rewarded the accompanying ministers, bestowed seventy bolts of brocade on Xi, and transferred him to Director in the Ministry of Revenue with charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the rebels were suppressed. The emperor rewarded the accompanying ministers, bestowed seventy bolts of brocade on Xi, and transferred him to Director in the Ministry of Revenue with charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 十二月，正拜中書舍人，充職如故。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was formally appointed Secretariat Drafter, continuing in his duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was formally appointed Secretariat Drafter while continuing in his duties as before.

sentences.zh: 謝恩於思政殿，因諫敬宗，以求理莫若躬親，用示憂勤之旨也。

translations.literal: When giving thanks at Sizheng Hall, he remonstrated with Jingzong that in seeking good governance nothing surpasses personal involvement, thereby showing the intent of concern and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: When giving thanks at Sizheng Hall, he remonstrated with Jingzong that in seeking good governance nothing surpasses personal involvement, thereby expressing the principle of concern and diligence.

sentences.zh: 帝深納其言，又賜錦彩五十匹。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply accepted his words and again bestowed fifty bolts of brocade.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply accepted his words and again bestowed fifty bolts of brocade.

sentences.zh: 寶曆二年三月，罷學士，守本官。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Baoli, he was removed from the Hanlin Academy and retained his original office.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of Baoli, he was removed from the Hanlin Academy and retained his original office.

sentences.zh: 太和三年七月，授刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Taihe, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of Taihe, he was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 銓綜之司，官業振舉。

translations.literal: In the office of selection and review, official business was vigorously conducted.
translations.idiomatic: In the office of selection and review, official business was vigorously conducted.

sentences.zh: 七年，出為同州刺史、兼御史中丞。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he went out as Prefect of Tong Prefecture, also serving as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was sent out as Prefect of Tong Prefecture, also serving as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八年六月卒，贈兵部尚書，遺命薄葬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year he died; he was posthumously granted Minister of the Ministry of War, and left instructions for a simple burial.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year he died. He was posthumously granted Minister of the Ministry of War and left instructions for a simple burial.

sentences.zh: 釴少時孤貧，潔己力行，與弟銖、鍇皆以檢靜自立，致位崇顯，居家友睦，為搢紳所重。

translations.literal: Xi in youth was orphaned and poor; he kept himself pure and acted with effort. He and his younger brothers Zhu and Kai all established themselves through restraint and quiet conduct, reached eminent positions, lived harmoniously at home, and were respected by the gentry.
translations.idiomatic: Xi was orphaned and poor in youth. He kept himself pure and acted with integrity. He and his younger brothers Zhu and Kai all established themselves through restraint and quiet conduct, reached eminent positions, lived harmoniously at home, and were respected by the gentry.

sentences.zh: 釴弟 銖銖，元和六年登進士第。

translations.literal: Xi's younger brother Zhu passed the jinshi examination in the sixth year of Yuanhe.
translations.idiomatic: Xi's younger brother Zhu passed the jinshi examination in the sixth year of Yuanhe.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，入朝為監察御史，累遷員外郎、吏部郎中。

translations.literal: When Muzong acceded, Zhu entered court as Investigating Censor and through successive promotions reached Vice Director and Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong acceded, Zhu entered court as Investigating Censor and through successive promotions reached Vice Director and Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 太和五年，拜給事中。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taihe he was appointed Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Taihe he was appointed Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 七年，為外官監考使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he served as commissioner for examining external officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he served as commissioner for examining external officials.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，文宗用國子助教李仲言為侍講，銖率諫官伏閣論曰：「仲言素行纖邪，若聽用，必亂國經。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year, Wenzong employed National University Assistant Instructor Li Zhongyan as lecture attendant. Zhu led remonstrating officials to prostrate at the gate and argue, saying: "Zhongyan's conduct has long been petty and depraved; if he is employed, he is sure to disorder the state's institutions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year, Wenzong employed National University Assistant Instructor Li Zhongyan as lecture attendant. Zhu led remonstrating officials to prostrate at the gate and argue, saying, "Zhongyan's conduct has long been petty and depraved. If he is employed, he is sure to disorder the state's institutions.

sentences.zh: 」上令中使宣諭曰：「朕要仲言講書，非有聽用也。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered a palace envoy to proclaim: "I want Zhongyan to lecture on the classics; I do not intend to employ him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor ordered a palace envoy to proclaim, "I want Zhongyan to lecture on the classics; I do not intend to employ him.

sentences.zh: 」是歲，先旱後水，京師谷價騰踴；

translations.literal: " That year, drought came first and then flood; grain prices in the capital soared;
translations.idiomatic: " That year drought came first and then flood, and grain prices in the capital soared;

sentences.zh: 彗星為變，舉選皆停，人情雜然流議。

translations.literal: A comet appeared as an omen; all examinations and selections were halted; public sentiment was mixed with widespread discussion.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared as an omen; all examinations and selections were halted; public sentiment was mixed with widespread discussion.

sentences.zh: 鄭註奸謀，日聞於外。

translations.literal: Zheng Zhu's treacherous schemes were daily heard outside.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhu's treacherous schemes were daily heard outside the court.

sentences.zh: 銖等犯難論諍，冀上省悟。

translations.literal: Zhu and the others braved difficulty to argue and remonstrate, hoping the emperor would awaken.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu and the others braved danger to argue and remonstrate, hoping the emperor would awaken.

sentences.zh: 既奉宣傳，相顧失色，以其危亡可翹足而待也。

translations.literal: Once they received the proclamation, they looked at one another and lost color, thinking that ruin and extinction could be awaited by just lifting a foot.
translations.idiomatic: Once they received the proclamation, they looked at one another in dismay, thinking that disaster and ruin were imminent.

sentences.zh: 明年，訓、註竊權，惡銖不附己，五月，出為越州刺史、御史中丞、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: The next year Xun and Zhu usurped power; hating Zhu for not attaching himself to them, in the fifth month they sent him out as Prefect of Yue Prefecture, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Xun and Zhu usurped power. Hating Zhu for not siding with them, in the fifth month they sent him out as Prefect of Yue Prefecture, Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Zhedong Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 開成三年，就加檢校左散騎常侍，尋入為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaicheng he was additionally appointed Acting Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry; soon he entered court as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaicheng he was additionally appointed Acting Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry. Soon he entered court as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，出為河南尹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year he went out as Intendant of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year he was sent out as Intendant of Henan.

sentences.zh: 會昌末，為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: At the end of the Huichang reign he served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Huichang reign he served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 釴弟 鍇鍇，元和九年登進士第，升宏辭科，累遷吏部員外。

translations.literal: Xi's younger brother Kai passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Yuanhe, advanced in the Hongci examination, and through successive promotions reached Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Xi's younger brother Kai passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Yuanhe, advanced in the Hongci examination, and through successive promotions reached Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 太和三年，準敕試別頭進士明經鄭齊之等十八人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taihe, per edict he tested eighteen alternate-track jinshi and classics graduates including Zheng Qizhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Taihe, per edict he tested eighteen alternate-track jinshi and classics graduates including Zheng Qizhi.

sentences.zh: 榜出之後，語辭紛競。

translations.literal: After the roster was issued, words and disputes were contentious.
translations.idiomatic: After the roster was issued, disputes and contentious talk arose.

sentences.zh: 監察御史姚中立以聞，詔鍇審定。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Yao Zhongli reported this; an edict ordered Kai to review and decide.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Yao Zhongli reported this, and an edict ordered Kai to review and decide.

sentences.zh: 乃升李景、王淑等，人以為公。

translations.literal: Thereupon he promoted Li Jing, Wang Shu, and others; people considered this fair.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he promoted Li Jing, Wang Shu, and others, and people considered the decision fair.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，自司勛郎中轉諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year he transferred from Director in the Bureau of Merits to Remonstrance Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year he transferred from Director in the Bureau of Merits to Remonstrance Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，以本官權知禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, while retaining his original office, he was temporarily placed in charge of the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year, while retaining his original office, he was temporarily placed in charge of the Ministry of Rites examination.

sentences.zh: 開成元年春，試畢，進呈及第人名，文宗謂侍臣曰：「從前文格非佳，昨出進士題目，是朕出之，所試似勝去年。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Kaicheng, when the examination was complete, the names of those who passed were presented. Wenzong said to attending ministers: "Former literary forms were not good; yesterday the jinshi examination topics issued were mine, and what was tested seems better than last year.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the first year of Kaicheng, when the examination was complete, the names of those who passed were presented. Wenzong said to the attending ministers, "Former literary forms were not good. Yesterday the jinshi examination topics issued were mine, and what was tested seems better than last year.

sentences.zh: 」鄭覃曰：「陛下改詩賦格調，以正頹俗，然高鍇亦能勵精選士，仰副聖旨。

translations.literal: " Zheng Tan said: "Your Majesty changed the style of poetry and rhapsody to correct declining custom; yet Gao Kai also was able to exert himself in selecting scholars, looking up to fulfill the sage intent.
translations.idiomatic: " Zheng Tan said, "Your Majesty changed the style of poetry and rhapsody to correct declining custom, and Gao Kai also exerted himself in selecting scholars, fulfilling the imperial intent.

sentences.zh: 」帝又曰：「近日諸侯章奏，語太浮華，有乖典實。

translations.literal: " The emperor again said: "Recently the memorials of regional lords are too florid in language and depart from canonical substance.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor again said, "Recently the memorials of regional lords are too florid in language and depart from canonical substance.

sentences.zh: 宜罰掌書記，以誡其流。

translations.literal: They ought to punish the chief secretaries to warn against this trend.
translations.idiomatic: They ought to punish the chief secretaries to warn against this trend.

sentences.zh: 」李石曰：「古人因事為文，今人以文害事，懲弊抑末，實在盛時。

translations.literal: " Li Shi said: "The ancients wrote according to affairs; today men harm affairs with writing. To punish abuses and restrain the secondary—truly this belongs in a flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Shi said, "The ancients wrote according to affairs; today men harm affairs with writing. To punish abuses and restrain the secondary truly belongs in a flourishing age.

sentences.zh: 」乃以鍇為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Kai was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Kai was appointed Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 凡掌貢部三年，每歲登第者四十人。

translations.literal: In all he held charge of the examination department for three years; each year forty men passed.
translations.idiomatic: In all he held charge of the examination department for three years, and each year forty men passed.

sentences.zh: 三年，榜出後，敕曰：「進士每歲四十人，其數過多，則乖精選。

translations.literal: In the third year, after the roster was issued, an edict said: "Each year forty jinshi pass; if the number is too great, it departs from careful selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, after the roster was issued, an edict said, "Each year forty jinshi pass. If the number is too great, it departs from careful selection.

sentences.zh: 官途填委，要窒其源，宜改每年限放三十人，如不登其數，亦聽。

translations.literal: Official paths are filled and piled up; the essential thing is to block their source. It is fitting to change to a yearly limit of thirty men released; if the number is not reached, that too is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The official ranks are overcrowded, and the source must be choked off. The yearly quota should be reduced to thirty graduates; if fewer than that number qualify, that too is permitted.

sentences.zh: 」然鍇選擢雖多，頗得實才，抑豪華，擢孤進，至今稱之。

translations.literal: " Yet though Kai's selections and promotions were many, he obtained quite a few men of real talent, restrained the grand and luxurious, and promoted the isolated and advancing; to this day he is praised for it.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet although Kai selected and promoted many candidates, he found men of genuine talent, checked the grand and ostentatious, and elevated those who had risen alone—and to this day he is praised for it.

sentences.zh: 尋轉吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 其年九月，出為鄂州刺史、御史大夫、鄂嶽觀察使，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of that year he was sent out as Prefect of Ezhou, Grand Censor, and E-Yue Observation Commissioner, and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of that year he was posted as Prefect of Ezhou, Grand Censor, and E-Yue Observation Commissioner, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 釴子湜，鍇子湘，偕登進士第。

translations.literal: Yi's son Shi and Kai's son Xiang both passed the jinshi examination together.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's son Shi and Kai's son Xiang both passed the jinshi examination in the same year.

sentences.zh: 湜，咸通十二年為禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Shi, in the twelfth year of Xiantong, served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Xiantong, Shi served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 湘自員外郎知制誥，正拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: Xiang, from Supernumerary Gentleman drafting edicts, was formally appointed Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang rose from Supernumerary Gentleman with charge of drafting edicts to a formal appointment as Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 咸通年，改諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he was changed to Remonstrance Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantong era he was transferred to Remonstrance Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 坐宰相劉瞻親厚，貶高州司馬。

translations.literal: Because of his close ties with Chief Minister Liu Zhan, he was demoted to Military Assistant of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his close ties with Chief Minister Liu Zhan, he was demoted to Military Assistant of Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 乾符初，復為中書舍人。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianfu he was again made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Qianfu era he was again appointed Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 三年，遷禮部侍郎，選士得人。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites and in selecting scholars obtained the right men.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites and, in selecting candidates, chose men of real merit.

sentences.zh: 出為潞州大都督府長史、昭義節度、澤潞觀察等使，卒。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Chief Secretary of the Lu Prefecture Grand Protectorate, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, and Ze-Lu Observation Commissioner, and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as Chief Secretary of the Lu Prefecture Grand Protectorate, Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi, and Ze-Lu Observation Commissioner, and died in office.

sentences.zh: =馮宿=

translations.literal: =Feng Su=
translations.idiomatic: Feng Su

sentences.zh: 馮宿，東陽人。

translations.literal: Feng Su was a man of Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Su was a native of Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 丱歲隨父子華廬祖墓，有靈芝、白兔之祥。

translations.literal: In his childhood he followed his father Zihua to dwell at the ancestral tomb, and there were auspicious signs of spirit fungus and a white hare.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he followed his father Zihua to live at the ancestral tomb, where auspicious signs appeared in the form of spirit fungus and a white hare.

sentences.zh: 宿昆弟二人，皆幼有文學。

translations.literal: Su and his two brothers all showed literary talent from youth.
translations.idiomatic: Su and his two brothers all showed literary talent from an early age.

sentences.zh: 宿登進士第，徐州節度張建封辟為掌書記。

translations.literal: Su passed the jinshi examination, and Xu Prefecture Military Commissioner Zhang Jianfeng summoned him as chief secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Su passed the jinshi examination, and Zhang Jianfeng, Military Commissioner of Xuzhou, summoned him to serve as chief secretary.

sentences.zh: 後建封卒，其子愔為軍士所立，李師古欲乘喪襲取。

translations.literal: Later Jianfeng died. His son Yin was installed by the troops, and Li Shigu wished to seize the opportunity during mourning to attack and take the territory.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after Jianfeng died, his son Yin was installed by the troops, and Li Shigu sought to exploit the mourning period to seize the command by force.

sentences.zh: 時王武俊且觀其釁，愔恐懼，計無所出。

translations.literal: At the time Wang Wujun was also watching for an opening, and Yin was afraid, with no plan to get out of it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wang Wujun was also watching for an opening, and Yin was terrified, with no plan to save himself.

sentences.zh: 宿乃以檄書招師古，而說武俊曰：「張公與君為兄弟，欲同力驅兩河歸天子，眾所知也。

translations.literal: Su then sent a proclamation summoning Shigu, and said to Wujun: "Lord Zhang and you were as brothers, wishing together to drive the Two He regions back to the Son of Heaven—this is known to all.
translations.idiomatic: Su then sent a proclamation summoning Shigu and said to Wujun, "Lord Zhang and you were as brothers, both wishing to drive the Two He regions back to the Son of Heaven—everyone knows this.

sentences.zh: 今張公歿，幼子為亂兵所脅，內則誠款隔絕於朝廷，外則境土侵逼於強寇。

translations.literal: Now Lord Zhang is dead. His young son is coerced by mutinous troops; inwardly his loyal submission is cut off from the court, and outwardly his territory is pressed by strong enemies.
translations.idiomatic: Now Lord Zhang is dead. His young son is held hostage by mutinous troops; inwardly his loyal submission is cut off from the court, and outwardly his territory is menaced by powerful foes.

sentences.zh: 孤危若此，公安得坐視哉！

translations.literal: Alone and endangered like this—how can you sit and watch!
translations.idiomatic: Alone and endangered like this—how can you simply sit and watch!

sentences.zh: 誠能奏天子，念先僕射之忠勛，舍其子之迫脅，使得束身自歸，則公於朝廷有靖亂之功，於張氏有繼絕之德矣！

translations.literal: If you can truly memorialize the Son of Heaven, recalling the former Pushe's loyal merit, overlooking the coercion of his son and allowing him to bind himself and return of his own accord, then you will have the merit of quelling disorder for the court and the virtue of continuing a severed line for the Zhang clan!
translations.idiomatic: If you can truly memorialize the Son of Heaven, recalling the former Pushe's loyal service, overlooking the coercion of his son and allowing him to surrender and return of his own accord, then you will have won the court the merit of quelling disorder and the Zhang clan the virtue of preserving a line that would otherwise have been cut off!

sentences.zh: 」武俊大悅，即以表聞。

translations.literal: " Wujun was greatly pleased and immediately reported this by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: " Wujun was greatly pleased and immediately reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 由是朝廷賜愔節鉞，仍贈建封司徒。

translations.literal: Thereby the court bestowed on Yin the commission and battle-axe, and additionally posthumously enfeoffed Jianfeng as Situ.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the court bestowed on Yin the commission and battle-axe, and posthumously enfeoffed Jianfeng as Situ.

sentences.zh: 宿以嘗從建封，不樂與其子處，乃從浙東觀察使賈全府辟。

translations.literal: Su, because he had once served under Jianfeng, was unwilling to remain with his son, and therefore accepted a summons from Zhedong Observation Commissioner Jia Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Because Su had once served under Jianfeng, he was unwilling to remain with his son and instead accepted a summons from Jia Quan, Observation Commissioner of Zhedong.

sentences.zh: 愔恨其去己，奏貶泉州司戶。

translations.literal: Yin resented his leaving him and memorialized to have him demoted to Revenue Assistant of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yin resented his departure and memorialized to have him demoted to Revenue Assistant of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 征為太常博士。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Master of Rites Doctor.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as a Master of Rites Doctor.

sentences.zh: 王士真死，以其子承宗不順，不加謚。

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen died, and because his son Chengzong was disobedient, no posthumous title was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Shizhen died, no posthumous title was granted because his son Chengzong was disobedient.

sentences.zh: 宿以為懷柔之義，不可遺其忠勞，乃加之美謚。

translations.literal: Su held that in the principle of gentle conciliation one must not forget his loyal service, and therefore added a fine posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Su held that the principle of gentle conciliation required that loyal service not be forgotten, and therefore added a fine posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 轉虞部、都官二員外郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Supernumerary Gentleman in the Bureaus of Parks and Forests and of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Supernumerary Gentleman in the Bureaus of Parks and Forests and of Justice.

sentences.zh: 元和十二年，從裴度東征，為彰義軍節度判官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yuanhe he followed Pei Du on the eastern campaign and served as administrative aide to the Military Commissioner of the Zhangyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Yuanhe he followed Pei Du on the eastern campaign and served as administrative aide to the Military Commissioner of the Zhangyi Army.

sentences.zh: 淮西平，拜比部郎中。

translations.literal: When Huai West was pacified, he was appointed Director in the Bureau of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: After Huai West was pacified, he was appointed Director in the Bureau of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 會韓愈論佛骨，時宰疑宿草疏，出為歙州刺史。

translations.literal: When Han Yu memorialized on the Buddha bone, the chief ministers suspected that Su had drafted the memorial, and he was sent out as Prefect of Shezhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Yu memorialized against the Buddha bone relic, the chief ministers suspected that Su had drafted the memorial, and he was sent out as Prefect of Shezhou.

sentences.zh: 入為刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the capital as Director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 十五年，權判考功。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was temporarily placed in charge of the Bureau of Evaluations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was temporarily placed in charge of the Bureau of Evaluations.

sentences.zh: 宿以宰臣及三品已下官，故事內校考，別封以進；

translations.literal: Su held that for chief ministers and officials of the third rank and below, by precedent the internal court evaluation was separately sealed and submitted;
translations.idiomatic: Su held that for chief ministers and officials of the third rank and below, precedent called for the internal court evaluation to be separately sealed and submitted;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士，職居內署，事莫能知，請依前書上考；

translations.literal: Hanlin Academicians, whose duties lie within the inner offices and whose affairs cannot be known, he requested should be recorded as before with the highest grade;
translations.idiomatic: as for Hanlin Academicians, whose duties lay within the inner offices and whose affairs could not be known, he requested that they continue to receive the highest grade as before;

sentences.zh: 諫官御史亦請仍舊，並書中上考。

translations.literal: remonstrance officials and censors also requested to follow the old practice, all being recorded with the middle highest grade.
translations.idiomatic: remonstrance officials and censors also requested that the old practice be followed, with all receiving the middle highest grade.

sentences.zh: 長慶元年，以本官知制誥。

translations.literal: In the first year of Changqing, while retaining his original office, he was given charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Changqing, while retaining his original office, he was given charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 二年，轉兵部郎中，依前充職。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War and continued to fill the office as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War and continued to fill the same office as before.

sentences.zh: 牛元翼以深州不從王庭湊，詔授襄州節度使。

translations.literal: Because Niu Yuanyi at Shen Prefecture would not submit to Wang Tingcou, an edict appointed him Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because Niu Yuanyi at Shen Prefecture refused to submit to Wang Tingcou, an edict appointed him Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元翼未出，深州為庭湊所圍。

translations.literal: Before Yuanyi could depart, Shen Prefecture was besieged by Tingcou.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yuanyi could depart, Shen Prefecture was besieged by Tingcou.

sentences.zh: 二年，以宿檢校右庶子、兼御史中丞，賜紫金魚袋，往總留務。

translations.literal: In the second year Su was made Acting Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household and concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief, granted the purple-gold fish tally, and sent to take overall charge of local affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Su was made Acting Right Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household and concurrently Vice Censor-in-Chief, granted the purple-gold fish tally, and sent to take overall charge of local affairs.

sentences.zh: 監軍使周進榮不遵詔命，宿以狀聞。

translations.literal: Army Supervisor Zhou Jinrong did not obey the edict command, and Su reported the facts to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Army Supervisor Zhou Jinrong disobeyed the edict, and Su reported the matter to the throne.

sentences.zh: 元翼既至，宿歸朝，拜中書舍人，轉太常少卿。

translations.literal: Once Yuanyi had arrived, Su returned to court, was appointed Secretariat Drafter, and was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yuanyi had arrived, Su returned to court, was appointed Secretariat Drafter, and was transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位，宿常導引乘輿，出為華州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, Su often guided the imperial carriage and was sent out as Prefect of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, Su often guided the imperial carriage and was posted as Prefect of Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以父名拜章乞罷，改左散騎常侍，兼集賢殿學士，充考制策官。

translations.literal: Because of his father's personal name he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal, and was changed to Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry, concurrently Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and appointed examiner of policy-essay candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father's personal name conflicted with the post, he submitted a memorial requesting dismissal and was reassigned as Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry, concurrently Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, with charge of examining policy-essay candidates.

sentences.zh: 太和二年，拜河南尹。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taihe he was appointed Prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taihe he was appointed Prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 時洛苑使姚文壽縱部下侵欺百姓，吏不敢捕。

translations.literal: At the time Luoyang Park Commissioner Yao Wenshou allowed his subordinates to encroach on and cheat the common people, and officials did not dare arrest them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Luoyang Park Commissioner Yao Wenshou allowed his subordinates to bully and cheat the common people, and officials did not dare arrest them.

sentences.zh: 一日，遇大會，嘗所捕者傲睨於文壽之側，宿知而掩之，杖死。

translations.literal: One day, during a great assembly, one whom he had once sought to arrest stared defiantly beside Wenshou. Su learned of it, seized him, and beat him to death.
translations.idiomatic: One day, during a great assembly, a man he had once sought to arrest stared defiantly at Wenshou's side. Su learned of it, seized the man, and had him beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 太和四年，入為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taihe he entered the capital as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Taihe he was recalled to the capital as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷刑部侍郎，修《格後敕》三十卷，遷兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice, compiled thirty fascicles of Supplementary Edicts After the Administrative Codes, and was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice, compiled thirty fascicles of the Supplementary Edicts After the Administrative Codes, and was then transferred to Vice Minister of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 九年，出為劍南東川節度使，檢校禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was sent out as Military Commissioner of Eastern Chuan in Jiannan, with acting appointment as Minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was posted as Military Commissioner of Eastern Chuan in Jiannan, with acting appointment as Minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 開成元年十二月卒，廢朝，贈吏部尚書，謚曰懿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the first year of Kaicheng he died. Court audiences were suspended. He was posthumously granted Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, with posthumous title Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Kaicheng he died. Court audiences were suspended. He was posthumously granted Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, with the posthumous title Yi.

sentences.zh: 有文集四十卷。

translations.literal: He left a collected writings in forty fascicles.
translations.idiomatic: He left collected writings in forty fascicles.

sentences.zh: 子圖、陶、韜，三人皆登進士，揚歷清顯。

translations.literal: His sons Tu, Tao, and Tao all passed the jinshi examination and rose through pure and eminent offices.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Tu, Tao, and Tao all passed the jinshi examination and rose through distinguished offices.

sentences.zh: 弟 定宿弟定，字介夫。

translations.literal: Younger brother Ding. Su's younger brother Ding, courtesy name Jiefu.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Ding. Su's younger brother Ding, courtesy name Jiefu.

sentences.zh: 儀貌壯偉，與宿俱有文學，而定過之。

translations.literal: His bearing and appearance were strong and imposing. He and Su both possessed literary talent, but Ding surpassed him.
translations.idiomatic: He was strong and imposing in bearing and appearance. He and Su both possessed literary talent, but Ding surpassed him.

sentences.zh: 貞元中皆舉進士，時人比之漢朝二馮君。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era both passed the jinshi examination, and men of the time compared them to the Two Fengs of the Han dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenyuan era both passed the jinshi examination, and men of the time compared them to the Two Fengs of the Han dynasty.

sentences.zh: 於頔牧姑蘇也，定寓焉，頔友於布衣間。

translations.literal: When Yu Di governed Gusu, Ding lodged there, and Di befriended him while still in commoner clothes.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu Di governed Gusu, Ding lodged there, and Di befriended him while he was still a commoner.

sentences.zh: 後頔帥襄陽，定乘驢詣軍門；

translations.literal: Later, when Di commanded Xiangyang, Ding rode a donkey to the army gate;
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Di took command at Xiangyang, Ding rode a donkey to the army gate;

sentences.zh: 吏不時白，定不留而去。

translations.literal: the clerks did not promptly announce him, and Ding did not stay but departed.
translations.idiomatic: the clerks did not promptly announce him, and Ding did not wait but departed.

sentences.zh: 頔慚，笞軍吏，馳載錢五十萬，及境謝之。

translations.literal: Di was ashamed, flogged the army clerks, galloped carrying five hundred thousand cash, and at the border apologized to him.
translations.idiomatic: Di was ashamed, flogged the army clerks, galloped after him with five hundred thousand cash, and apologized at the border.

sentences.zh: 定飯逆旅，復書責以貴傲而返其遺，頔深以為恨。

translations.literal: Ding ate at a roadside inn, wrote back reproaching him for the arrogance of rank, and returned the gift; Di deeply resented this.
translations.idiomatic: Ding ate at a roadside inn, wrote back reproaching him for the arrogance of rank, and returned the gift; Di deeply resented this.

sentences.zh: 權德輿掌貢士，擢居上第，後於澗州佐薛蘋幕，得校書郎，尋為鄠縣尉，充集賢校理。

translations.literal: Quan Deyu held charge of presenting candidates and placed him in the highest grade. Later he served on Xue Pin's staff in Jian Prefecture, obtained the post of Proofreader, and soon became magistrate of E County and was appointed collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Deyu, in charge of the examinations, placed him in the highest grade. Later he served on Xue Pin's staff in Jian Prefecture, obtained the post of Proofreader, and soon became magistrate of E County and collator in the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 定先時居父憂，因號毀得肺病，趨府或不及時，大學士疑其恃才簡怠，乃奪其職，俾為大理評事。

translations.literal: Ding had earlier been in mourning for his father and, through excessive grief, contracted lung disease. When hurrying to the office he sometimes could not arrive on time. The Grand Academician suspected him of relying on talent to be negligent and lax, and therefore stripped him of his post, making him a court reviewer in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Ding had earlier been in mourning for his father and, through excessive grief, contracted lung disease. When hurrying to the office he sometimes failed to arrive on time. The Grand Academician suspected him of relying on his talent to be negligent and lax, stripped him of his post, and made him a court reviewer in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 登朝為大常博士，轉祠部員外郎。

translations.literal: On entering court he served as Master of Rites Doctor and was transferred to Supernumerary Gentleman in the Bureau of Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On entering court he served as Master of Rites Doctor and was transferred to Supernumerary Gentleman in the Bureau of Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 寶歷二年，出為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoli he was sent out as Prefect of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoli he was posted as Prefect of Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 長壽縣尉馬洪沼告定強奪人妻，及將闕官職田祿粟入己費用，詔監察御史李顧行鞫之。

translations.literal: Changshou County Magistrate Ma Hongzhao accused Ding of forcibly seizing another man's wife and of appropriating for his own use the salary grain from official fields that should have gone to the state. An edict ordered Investigating Censor Li Guxing to interrogate the case.
translations.idiomatic: Changshou County Magistrate Ma Hongzhao accused Ding of forcibly seizing another man's wife and of appropriating for his own use the salary grain from official fields that should have gone to the state. An edict ordered Investigating Censor Li Guxing to investigate the case.

sentences.zh: 獄具上聞，制曰：「馮定經使臣推問，無入己贓私，所告罰錢，又皆公用。

translations.literal: When the case was complete it was reported upward. An edict said: "Feng Ding, after examination by commissioners, had no private embezzlement for himself; the fines reported were all used for public purposes.
translations.idiomatic: When the investigation was complete, an edict declared, "Feng Ding, after examination by commissioners, was found to have embezzled nothing for himself; the fines in question were all used for public purposes.

sentences.zh: 然長吏之體，頗涉無儀，刑賞或乖，宴遊不節。

translations.literal: Yet the deportment of a senior official was quite lacking in propriety; punishments and rewards were sometimes wrong, and feasting and pleasure were unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: Yet as a senior official his deportment was quite lacking in propriety; punishments and rewards were sometimes wrong, and his feasting and pleasure were unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 緣經恩赦，難更科書，猶持郡符，公議不可，宜停見任。

translations.literal: Because he had already received an amnesty, it was difficult to impose further statutory penalties, yet he still held the prefectural commission; public opinion would not allow it. He should be removed from his current post.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had already received an amnesty, further statutory penalties could not be imposed, yet he still held the prefectural commission—and public opinion would not allow it. He should be removed from his current post.

sentences.zh: 」尋除國子司業、河南少尹。

translations.literal: " Soon he was appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Education and Vice Prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward he was appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Education and Vice Prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 太和九年八月，為太常少卿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the ninth year of Taihe he became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the ninth year of Taihe he became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 文宗每聽樂，鄙鄭、衛聲，詔奉常習開元中《霓裳羽衣舞》，以《雲韶樂》和之。

translations.literal: Whenever Emperor Wenzong listened to music he despised the sounds of Zheng and Wei. An edict ordered the Director of Imperial Sacrifices to rehearse the Kaiyuan-era Rainbow Skirt and Feathered-Robe Dance, harmonized with the Cloud Harmony Music.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Emperor Wenzong listened to music he despised the licentious sounds of Zheng and Wei. An edict ordered the Director of Imperial Sacrifices to rehearse the Kaiyuan-era Rainbow Skirt and Feathered-Robe Dance, harmonized with the Cloud Harmony Music.

sentences.zh: 舞曲成，定總樂工閱於庭，定立於其間。

translations.literal: When the dance music was complete, Ding gathered the musicians for review in the courtyard and stood among them.
translations.idiomatic: When the dance music was complete, Ding gathered the musicians for review in the courtyard and stood among them.

sentences.zh: 文宗以其端凝若植，問其姓氏。

translations.literal: Wenzong, seeing him dignified and upright as if planted, asked his surname and given name.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong, seeing him dignified and upright as a planted pillar, asked his name.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士李玨對曰：「此馮定也。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Li Jue replied: "This is Feng Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Li Jue replied, "This is Feng Ding.

sentences.zh: 」文宗喜，問曰：「豈非能為古章句者耶？

translations.literal: " Wenzong was pleased and asked: "Is he not one who can compose classical verse?
translations.idiomatic: " Wenzong was pleased and asked, "Is this not the man who writes classical verse?

sentences.zh: 」乃召升階。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he summoned him to ascend the steps.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he summoned him to ascend the steps.

sentences.zh: 文宗自吟定《送客西江詩》，吟罷益喜，因錫禁中瑞錦，仍令大錄所著古體詩以獻。

translations.literal: Wenzong himself recited Ding's "Seeing Off a Guest on the Western River." When the recitation ended he was still more pleased, and therefore bestowed palace brocade from within the forbidden precincts, and also ordered a full transcription of his ancient-style poems to be presented.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong himself recited Ding's "Seeing Off a Guest on the Western River." When he finished he was still more pleased, bestowed palace brocade from within the forbidden precincts, and ordered a full transcription of his ancient-style poems to be presented.

sentences.zh: 尋遷諫議大夫、知匭事。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Remonstrance Grand Master and given charge of the suggestion box.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Remonstrance Grand Master and given charge of the suggestion box.

sentences.zh: 是歲，李訓事敗伏誅，衣冠橫罹其禍，中外危疑。

translations.literal: That year the affair of Li Xun failed and he was executed. Officials and gentry were struck down by the calamity in great numbers, and within and without the court there was fear and uncertainty.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Xun's plot failed and he was executed. Officials and gentry were struck down in great numbers, and fear and uncertainty spread within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 及改元禦殿，中尉仇士良請用神策仗衛在殿門；

translations.literal: When the era name was changed and the emperor took the throne in audience, Palace Commandant Qiu Shiliang requested that Shence Army ceremonial guards be used at the palace gates;
translations.idiomatic: When the era name was changed and the emperor took the throne in audience, Palace Commandant Qiu Shiliang requested that Shence Army ceremonial guards be posted at the palace gates;

sentences.zh: 定抗疏論罷，人情危之。

translations.literal: Ding submitted a forceful memorial arguing against it, and public sentiment feared for him.
translations.idiomatic: Ding submitted a forceful memorial arguing against it, and people feared for his safety.

sentences.zh: 又請許左右史隨宰臣入延英記事，宰臣不樂。

translations.literal: He also requested that the Left and Right Historiographers be allowed to follow chief ministers into Yanying Hall to record affairs, and the chief ministers were displeased.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that the Left and Right Historiographers be allowed to follow chief ministers into Yanying Hall to record proceedings, and the chief ministers were displeased.

sentences.zh: 二年，改太子詹事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was changed to Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household.

sentences.zh: 三年，宰臣鄭覃拜太子太師，欲於尚書省上事。

translations.literal: In the third year Chief Minister Zheng Tan was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince and wished to assume office at the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Chief Minister Zheng Tan was appointed Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince and wished to assume office at the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 定奏曰：「據《六典》，太師居詹事府，不合於都省禮上。

translations.literal: Ding memorialized: "According to the Six Statutes, the Grand Preceptor resides in the Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household and ought not to assume office by the rites of the central departments.
translations.idiomatic: Ding memorialized, "According to the Six Statutes, the Grand Preceptor resides in the Supervisor of the Crown Prince's Household and ought not to assume office by the rites of the central departments.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔於本司上事，人推美之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered him to assume office in his own bureau, and people praised this.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon an edict ordered him to assume office in his own bureau, and people praised the decision.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷衛尉卿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 是歲，上章請老，詔以左散騎常侍致仕。

translations.literal: That year he submitted a memorial requesting retirement. An edict granted him retirement as Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: That year he submitted a memorial requesting retirement and was granted retirement as Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 會昌六年，改工部尚書而卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Huichang he was changed to Minister of the Ministry of Works and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Huichang he was appointed Minister of the Ministry of Works and died.

sentences.zh: 先長慶中，源寂使新羅國，見其國人傳寫諷念定所為《黑水碑》、《畫鶴記》。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Changqing era, Yuan Ji was envoy to Silla and saw its people copying and reciting from Ding's "Black Water Stele Inscription" and "Record of Painting a Crane."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the Changqing era, Yuan Ji served as envoy to Silla and saw its people copying and reciting Ding's "Black Water Stele Inscription" and "Record of Painting a Crane."

sentences.zh: 韋休符之使西番也，見其國人寫定《商山記》於屏障。

translations.literal: When Wei Xiufu was envoy to the Western Tibetans, he saw its people writing Ding's "Mount Shang Record" on screens.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Xiufu served as envoy to the Western Tibetans, he saw its people writing Ding's "Mount Shang Record" on screens.

sentences.zh: 其文名馳於戎夷如此。

translations.literal: Thus his writings were famed among the frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Thus his writings were famed among the frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 子袞、顓、軒、巖四人，皆進士登第。

translations.literal: His sons Gun, Zhuan, Xuan, and Yan—four men—all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: His four sons Gun, Zhuan, Xuan, and Yan all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，歷任臺省。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era they successively held posts in the censorate and secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantong era they successively held posts in the censorate and secretariat.

sentences.zh: 宿從弟審、寬。

translations.literal: Su's younger cousins Shen and Kuan.
translations.idiomatic: Su's younger cousins Shen and Kuan.

sentences.zh: 從弟 審審父子郁。

translations.literal: Cousin Shen. Shen's son was Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Cousin Shen. Shen's son was Yu.

sentences.zh: 審，貞元十二年登進士第，累辟使府。

translations.literal: Shen passed the jinshi examination in the twelfth year of Zhenyuan and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs.
translations.idiomatic: Shen passed the jinshi examination in the twelfth year of Zhenyuan and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs.

sentences.zh: 入為監察御史，累遷至兵部郎中。

translations.literal: He entered as Investigating Censor and was promoted in succession to Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Investigating Censor and rose in succession to Director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 開成三年，遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaicheng he was transferred to Remonstrating Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaicheng he was transferred to Remonstrating Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 四年九月，出為桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year he was sent out as Prefect of Gui and Military Commissioner of the Gui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year he was sent out as Prefect of Gui and Military Commissioner of the Gui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 入為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: He entered as Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 國子監有《孔子碑》，睿宗篆額，加「大周」兩字，蓋武后時篆也。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education had a Stele of Confucius with an inscription by Emperor Ruizong, to which the two characters "Great Zhou" had been added—this was inscribed in the time of Empress Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Education had a Stele of Confucius with an inscription by Emperor Ruizong, to which the two characters "Great Zhou" had been added—this had been inscribed in the time of Empress Wu.

sentences.zh: 審請琢去偽號，復「大唐」字，從之。

translations.literal: Shen requested that the false title be carved away and the characters "Great Tang" restored; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Shen requested that the false title be carved away and the characters "Great Tang" restored, and his request was approved.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，卒於秘書監。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he died as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he died while serving as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 審弟 寬審弟寬，子緘，皆進士擢第，知名於時。

translations.literal: Shen's younger brother Kuan. Shen's younger brother Kuan and his son Jian all passed the jinshi examination and were renowned in the age.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Kuan. Shen's younger brother Kuan and his son Jian all passed the jinshi examination and were renowned in their time.

sentences.zh: =封敖=

translations.literal: =Feng Ao=
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ao

sentences.zh: 封敖，字碩夫，其先渤海蓚人。

translations.literal: Feng Ao, styled Shuofu, was originally from Su in Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ao, courtesy name Shuofu, came originally from Su in Bohai.

sentences.zh: 祖希奭。

translations.literal: His grandfather was Xiyi.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather was Xiyi.

sentences.zh: 父諒，官卑。

translations.literal: His father Liang held a low office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Liang held a low office.

sentences.zh: 敖，元和十年登進士第，累辟諸侯府。

translations.literal: Ao passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Yuanhe and was repeatedly recruited to feudatory staffs.
translations.idiomatic: Ao passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of Yuanhe and was repeatedly recruited to regional commissioner staffs.

sentences.zh: 太和中，入朝為右拾遺。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he entered court as Right Remembrancer.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he entered court as Right Remembrancer.

sentences.zh: 會昌初，以員外郎知制誥，召入翰林為學士，拜中書舍人。

translations.literal: In the early Huichang era, as Vice Director he served as Drafting Secretary, was summoned into the Hanlin as Academician, and was appointed Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Huichang era, as Vice Director he served as Drafting Secretary, was summoned into the Hanlin Academy as Academician, and was appointed Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 敖構思敏速，語近而理勝，不務奇澀，武宗深重之。

translations.literal: Ao conceived swiftly and composed with agility; his language was plain yet his reasoning prevailed, and he did not pursue the strange and obscure—Emperor Wuzong valued him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Ao conceived swiftly and composed with agility. His language was plain yet his reasoning prevailed, and he did not pursue the strange and obscure. Emperor Wuzong valued him deeply.

sentences.zh: 嘗草《賜陣傷邊將詔》，警句云：「傷居爾體，痛在朕躬。

translations.literal: He once drafted an Edict Conferring Rewards on Wounded Frontier Generals, with a striking line saying, "The wound lies in your body, but the pain is in My person."
translations.idiomatic: He once drafted an Edict Conferring Rewards on Wounded Frontier Generals, with a striking line: "The wound lies in your body, but the pain is in My person."

sentences.zh: 」帝覽而善之，賜之宮錦。

translations.literal: " The emperor read it and approved, bestowing palace brocade on him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor read it and approved, bestowing palace brocade on him.

sentences.zh: 李德裕在相位，定策破回鶻，誅劉稹。

translations.literal: When Li Deyu was chief minister, he settled strategy to break the Uyghurs and executed Liu Zong.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Deyu was chief minister, he settled strategy to defeat the Uyghurs and executed Liu Zong.

sentences.zh: 議兵之際，同列或有不可之言，唯德裕籌計指畫，竟立奇功。

translations.literal: When military affairs were discussed, colleagues sometimes had words of dissent; only Deyu planned and directed, and in the end established extraordinary merit.
translations.idiomatic: When military affairs were discussed, colleagues sometimes dissented. Only Deyu planned and directed, and in the end established extraordinary merit.

sentences.zh: 武宗賞之，封衛國公，守太尉。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong rewarded him, enfeoffed him as Duke of Wei, and appointed him Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong rewarded him, enfeoffed him as Duke of Wei, and appointed him Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 其制語有：「遏橫議於風波，定奇謀於掌握。

translations.literal: The appointment prose included: "He checked reckless debate amid wind and waves and settled extraordinary stratagems within his grasp."
translations.idiomatic: The appointment prose included: "He checked reckless debate amid wind and waves and settled extraordinary stratagems within his grasp."

sentences.zh: 逆稹盜兵，壺關晝鎖，造膝嘉話，開懷靜思，意皆我同，言不他惑。

translations.literal: When the rebel Zong raised troops in rebellion, Huguan was locked by day; at intimate audience he offered fine counsel, and with open heart and quiet thought our intentions were alike and his words led no other astray.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel Zong raised troops in rebellion, Huguan was locked by day. At intimate audience he offered fine counsel, and with open heart and quiet thought our intentions were alike and his words led no other astray.

sentences.zh: 」制出，敖往慶之，德裕口誦此數句，撫敖曰：「陸生有言，所恨文不迨意。

translations.literal: " When the appointment was issued, Ao went to congratulate him; Deyu recited these several lines from memory and, patting Ao, said, "Master Lu said that what one regrets is when writing fails to match intent."
translations.idiomatic: " When the appointment was issued, Ao went to congratulate him. Deyu recited these several lines from memory and, patting Ao, said, "Master Lu said that what one regrets is when writing fails to match intent."

sentences.zh: 如卿此語，秉筆者不易措言。

translations.literal: With words like yours, the one who holds the brush cannot easily set them down.
translations.idiomatic: With words like yours, the one who holds the brush cannot easily set them down.

sentences.zh: 」座中解其所賜玉帶以遺敖，深禮重之。

translations.literal: " In the gathering he removed the jade belt he had been granted and gave it to Ao, honoring him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: " In the gathering he removed the jade belt he had been granted and gave it to Ao, honoring him deeply.

sentences.zh: 然敖不持士範，人重其才而輕其所為，德裕不能大用之。

translations.literal: Yet Ao did not uphold the model of a gentleman; men valued his talent but looked lightly on his conduct, and Deyu could not employ him to the full.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Ao did not uphold the model of a gentleman. Men valued his talent but looked lightly on his conduct, and Deyu could not employ him to the full.

sentences.zh: 德裕罷相，敖亦罷內職。

translations.literal: When Deyu was removed as chief minister, Ao also lost his inner post.
translations.idiomatic: When Deyu was removed as chief minister, Ao also lost his inner post.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，遷禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, Ao was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong took the throne, Ao was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 大中二年，典貢部，多擢文士。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong he presided over the examination bureau and promoted many men of letters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong he presided over the examination bureau and promoted many men of letters.

sentences.zh: 轉吏部侍郎、渤海男、食邑七百戶。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, made Baron of Bohai, and granted a fief of seven hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel, made Baron of Bohai, and granted a fief of seven hundred households.

sentences.zh: 四年，出為興元尹、御史大夫、山南西道節度使，歷左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was sent out as Prefect of Xingyuan, Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner of Shannan West Circuit, and served as Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was sent out as Prefect of Xingyuan, Censor-in-Chief, and Military Commissioner of Shannan West Circuit, and also served as Left Regular Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 十一年，拜太常卿，出為淄青節度使，入為戶部尚書，卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, sent out as Military Commissioner of Ziqing, recalled as Minister of Revenue, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, sent out as Military Commissioner of Ziqing, recalled as Minister of Revenue, and died.

sentences.zh: 子彥卿、望卿，從子特卿，皆進士及第，咸通後，歷位清顯。

translations.literal: His sons Yanqing and Wangqing and his nephew Teqing all passed the jinshi examination; after Xiantong they held eminent offices.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Yanqing and Wangqing and his nephew Teqing all passed the jinshi examination. After the Xiantong era they held eminent offices.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：韋公鯁亮守官，犯而得禮。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Lord Wei was upright and bright in holding office—he offended yet obtained what was proper.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Lord Wei was upright and bright in holding office. He offended yet obtained what was proper.

sentences.zh: 蕭子恬於吏隱，抑亦名賢。

translations.literal: Master Xiao was content in official retirement; he too was a famed worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Master Xiao was content in official retirement. He too was a famed worthy.

sentences.zh: 蔚章操韻非高，而從容長者。

translations.literal: Weizhang's conduct and tone were not lofty, yet he was an easygoing elder.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhang's conduct and tone were not lofty, yet he was an easygoing elder.

sentences.zh: 郁、朗襟概，郁有世風。

translations.literal: Yu and Lang had breadth of spirit; Yu had the manner of his generation.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Lang had breadth of spirit. Yu had the manner of his generation.

sentences.zh: 三高並秀於一時，二馮爭驅於千里，威以摛英掞藻，華國揚名。

translations.literal: The three Gao all flourished together in one age; the two Feng vied in galloping a thousand li—by wielding fine phrases and splendid diction they glorified the state and spread their fame.
translations.idiomatic: The three Gao all flourished together in one age. The two Feng vied in galloping a thousand li. By wielding fine phrases and splendid diction they glorified the state and spread their fame.

sentences.zh: 潤色之能，封無與讓，壽考垂慶，儒何負哉！

translations.literal: In the power to polish and adorn, Feng had no equal; long life brought down blessings—what did the Confucian scholar lack!
translations.idiomatic: In the power to polish and adorn, Feng had no equal. Long life brought down blessings—what did the Confucian scholar lack!

sentences.zh: 贊曰：伏蒲進諫，染翰為文。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Prostrating at the rush mat to remonstrate, staining the brush to compose literature.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Prostrating at the rush mat to remonstrate, staining the brush to compose literature.

sentences.zh: 獨孤、韋氏，誌在匡君。

translations.literal: The Dugu and Wei clans set their will on aiding the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The Dugu and Wei clans set their will on aiding the ruler.

sentences.zh: 馮、高諸子，綺繡繽紛。

translations.literal: The sons of Feng and Gao were brocade and embroidery in profusion.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of Feng and Gao were brocade and embroidery in profusion.

sentences.zh: 禁垣擅美，渤海淩云。

translations.literal: Within the forbidden precincts they monopolized beauty; from Bohai they rose to the clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Within the forbidden precincts they monopolized literary excellence; from Bohai they rose to the clouds.
